newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - September 12.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - September 12.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had no large one-day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.

As for the pattern of borrowing, about 78 percent of the adjustment borrowing in the week was done by the small banks, while about 22 percent was done by the money centers. No borrowing was done by the large regional banks.
As for the pattern of borrowing on Wednesday, all of the borrowing was done by the small banks, none was done by the large regionals and money centers.
The high in natural float was about $1.6 billion on Tuesday, while the low was about $875 million on Monday.
Transportation float averaged about $35 million per day with the high on Thursday at about $100 million due to air traffic delays in Miami and Richmond and a missed connection in Pittsburg.
